# telnyx_documents (Data Source)

Lists documents, with optional filters. Each item has the attributes of `telnyx_document`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter_created_at_gt` (String) Filter by created at greater than provided value.
- `filter_created_at_lt` (String) Filter by created at less than provided value.
- `filter_customer_reference` (String) Filter documents by a customer reference.
- `filter_customer_reference_in` (List of String) Filter documents by a list of customer references.
- `filter_filename_contains` (String) Filter by string matching part of filename.
- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.
- `sort` (List of String) Specifies the sort order for results. If you want to sort by a field in ascending order, include it as a sort parameter. If you want to sort in descending order, prepend a `-` in front of the field name.

### Read-Only

- `documents` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--documents))

<a id="nestedatt--documents"></a>
### Nested Schema for `documents`

Read-Only:

- `av_scan_status` (String) The antivirus scan status of the document.
- `content_type` (String) The document's content_type.
- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date-time indicating when the resource was created.
- `customer_reference` (String) Optional reference string for customer tracking.
- `filename` (String) The filename of the document.
- `id` (String) Identifies the resource.
- `record_type` (String) Identifies the type of the resource.
- `sha256` (String) The document's SHA256 hash provided for optional verification purposes.
- `size` (Attributes) Indicates the document's filesize (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--documents--size))
- `status` (String) Indicates the current document reviewing status
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date-time indicating when the resource was updated.

<a id="nestedatt--documents--size"></a>
### Nested Schema for `documents.size`

Read-Only:

- `amount` (Number) The number of bytes
- `unit` (String) Identifies the unit
